skills.name: Tidal Thought (汐念/潮汐の思い)
skills.line: I will protect the wishes of the merfolk.
skills.description: Tides rise with the songs under the misty nebulous clouds, SP Senhime attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Merfolk Song (鮫人歌/人魚の唄)
skills.description: Exclusive effect. At start of battle, SP Senhime gains the Tidal's Blessing: it converts all removable control effects inflicted on her into Rest in Ice; upon being KO'd summons 1 Midnight Whale, lasts for 1 turn. ;Upon Usage :SP Senhime shares Tidal's Blessing with another non-summoned ally, lasts for 1 turn. ;Midnight Whale (永夜鯨) :Max of 2 whales. When taking an action, grants 1 onibi and grants all allies a shield that can absorb damage equal to 98% of SP Senhime's ATK.

upgrades.text: Duration of the shared Tidal's Blessing increases to 2 turns.
Duration of the Midnight Whale's presence increases to 2 turns.
When receiving damage while Resting in Ice, gain a shield equal to the damage, lasts for 1 turn.
If the HP of the ally with Tidal's Blessing loses 80% or more of their HP, they immediately Rest in Ice.

skills.name: Resurgent Dream (鯨息洄夢/鯨の幻夢)
skills.line: This is the Sea of Eternity where the song of the whales forever echoes and tides flow into eternity.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. A new form of eternity is born when the legacy carries on. SP Senhime creates the Sea of Eternity field, lasts for 2 turns. While the field is active, decreases the costs of onibi using skills for all allies by 1. Also whenever allies deal non-transferred damage to non-summoned enemies, inflicts Sea Frozen equal to 20% of the damage. When the field is created again while it is already active, summons 1 Daylight Whale, lasts for 1 turn. ;Sea Frozen (海凝/海氷) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 9 stacks. Each stack stores up to 5000% of SP Senhime's initial ATK. When a Daylight Whale takes an action, deals indirect direct damage and removes all stacks. ;Daylight Whale (極昼鯨/白夜鯨) :Max of 2 whales. When taking an action, inflicts Sea Frozen on 3 enemies with the lowest HP, storing damage equal to 158% of SP Senhime's ATK.

upgrades.text: While the field is active, and at the end of a non-summoned enemy's turn, increases the move bar of the Midnight Whale and Daylight Whale by 10%.
Increases Sea Frozen's damage multiplier to 30%.
Duration of the Daylight Whale's presence increases to 2 turns.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically creates the Sea of Eternity field at the start of battle.

bio.condition: Summon the Midnight Whale and Daylight Whale 100 times.
